description: Every property an owner (by owner_key) or a mailing address has ever been recorded on, newest first, with whether they still own it, when they acquired it and the recorded price. Includes summary counts. Searching by mailing address groups LLCs and trusts that share a mailbox.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, to fetch the next page.

mailing.description: Exact mailing address as stored (from a property or owner record).

owner_key.description: owner_key from search_owners (an exact name also works; it is normalized).
